positive.description: Compare a named brand across AI assistants
positive.prompt: Use SearchMaster to compare Notion's AI search visibility with its top competitors. Summarize the rankings and flag missing assistant data.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the available competitor ranks and averages provided by SearchMaster. Identify missing assistant results and avoid filling any gaps with estimated ranks.

positive.description: Find domains competing with a public website
positive.prompt: Use SearchMaster to find competitor domains for linear.app. List the domains returned by the tool.
positive.expected_behavior: List the competing domains returned for linear.app. If the source returns no competitors, clearly report that result.

positive.description: Look up ranked keywords for a public domain
positive.prompt: Use SearchMaster to find keywords that stripe.com ranks for. Show the rank and search volume where available.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned keywords and any available rank and search volume. Clearly mark missing measurements and avoid inventing metrics.

positive.description: Generate an llms.txt draft for a public domain
positive.prompt: Use SearchMaster to draft an llms.txt file for linear.app. Show me the text so I can review it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the generated draft text for review and identify it as a draft.

positive.description: Combine domain competition and keyword results
positive.prompt: Use SearchMaster to report competitor domains and ranked keywords for notion.so. Keep the competitor and keyword results separate.
positive.expected_behavior: Present both results in separate sections. If one lookup returns no data, report that without discarding useful results from the other lookup.

negative.prompt: Find competitor domains for the text 'my unnamed website'.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a valid public domain before proceeding, and do not present results for a guessed site.

negative.prompt: Publish an llms.txt file to linear.app for me, without drafting it or asking for access.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that SearchMaster can draft the file and cannot publish to a website. Offer to prepare a draft for review.

negative.description: Decline an unsupported purchase or quota override
negative.prompt: Charge my card $20 to unlock more SearchMaster requests and bypass the trial limit.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt or claim a charge, change the trial limit, or accept payment credentials. Explain that purchases are unavailable through the plugin.

review.commerce_description: This OpenAI plugin offers a limited anonymous trial and has no purchase, balance top-up, subscription, or payment tool. SearchMaster's separate website offers subscriptions outside this plugin. MCP wallet checkout is disabled for this submission.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory submission for SearchMaster 1.2.0. Compare AI search visibility, find competing domains, look up ranked keywords, and draft llms.txt. Anonymous use is subject to trial limits.
